newsitem.title: CHINA: Sithe has Marubeni funding on China project.
newsitem.headline: Sithe has Marubeni funding on China project.

text.p: An affiliate of Sithe Energies Inc said it has obtained a $20.3 million loan commitment from Japan's Marubeni Corp to finance a power project in southeastern China.
Sithe China Holdings Ltd, a power development company, said the loan would be used to finance a 45-megawatt combined cycle power generation facility in Changzhou city.
The company controlling the plant is 80 percent owned by Sithe China while the Changzhou City Power General Industry Co and Changzhou Hi-Tech Zone General Co each holds 10 percent.
The Changzhou Power Supply Co has signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with the company and Changzhou Investment Trust has provided a power purchase guarantee.
The plant will be transferred to Chinese government control after 20 years.
Sithe China is 39 percent owned by Sithe Energies while AIG Asian Infrastructure Fund holds 30.5 percent and Singapore Investment Corp has 30.5 percent.
Compagnie Generale des Eaux of France is the principal shareholder in U.S.-based Sithe Energies while Marubeni holds 29 percent.
